sectionDescription: Controls when the "On this page" table of contents is shown while viewing a page.
checkboxLabel: Always show the table of contents
checkboxDescription: By default the table of contents only appears once a page has more than 3 headings. Turn this on to always show it, even on pages with just one or two headings.
updateError: Could not update the table of contents setting
contentWidthSectionDescription: Controls how wide the text of a page is while viewing it. Applies to everyone, including visitors who are not signed in.
contentWidthDescription: The default keeps text in a narrow column that is easy to read. Wide uses the full width of the page area. The editor preview and page history keep the narrow column.
contentWidthUpdateError: Could not update the page width
subpageCountSectionDescription: Shows how many subpages a section contains, in the navigation tree and in the section overview. Applies to everyone, including visitors who are not signed in.
subpageCountCheckboxDescription: Each section shows the number of pages and sections directly inside it. Pages a visitor cannot see are not counted.
subpageCountUpdateError: Could not update the subpage count setting
